verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels and CRM setup still to launch.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every lead-gen action came from Google Business Profile — no paid campaigns ran on Meta or Google Ads, so there are no paid leads or spend to report for the last 28 days. Combined, your three profiles drove 403 GBP actions (directions, calls, and web clicks), which confirms real local search interest is present. That said, GBP engagement softened toward the end of the period at Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision specifically, with sharp drops in the final three days of the window. CRM setup milestones dating back to July are being resolved on schedule for an August 31 completion, which is the prerequisite before paid campaigns and outreach sequences go live. Once those blockers clear, paid activity and structured outreach will begin, and this report will have lead volume and cost-per-lead figures to show.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement dropped sharply in the final three days of the period at Forte Metals (−58% week-over-week) and O'Hare Precision (−43% week-over-week), with near-zero daily actions on August 25–27.
watch_item.fix: Listing visibility is being reviewed alongside the broader web and SEO root-cause audit due August 31; if a profile or indexing issue is confirmed, a fix will be submitted in the same window.
